summary: Build resilient, secure, and cost-effective multi-cloud data platforms. Master open table formats, Trino, FinOps, and zero-trust data governance. Register now.
lede: Multi-cloud data platform architecture training is for senior data practitioners and architecture leaders who design and operate distributed data systems. It develops practical approaches to decoupling storage, configuring federated queries, unifying metadata and lineage, applying cross-cloud access controls, and allocating costs, alongside resilience and failover planning through applied scenario exercises.
audienceIntro: This advanced programme is designed for senior technical practitioners and architecture leaders who design, govern, and maintain mission-critical data systems across multi-cloud infrastructures. This course is designed for: Data Platform Lead managing cross-cloud ingestion pipelines and distributed lakehouse infrastructure. Principal Enterprise Architect standardizing multi-cloud data architecture and technology stack roadmaps. Senior Data Engineer designing federated query engines, data lakes, and pipelines. Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Architect implementing cross-cloud networking, storage synchronization, and compute tiers. IT Risk and Compliance Manager auditing data residency, sovereign boundaries, and access logs. Data Governance Specialist configuring unified metadata catalogs, data contracts, and lineage tracing. FinOps Practitioner tracking cross-cloud compute consumption, egress tariffs, and cost allocation. Cloud Security Architect engineering zero-trust encryption and federated identity access policies. Senior Business Intelligence Architect optimizing distributed data warehouse performance and caching layers. Analytics Operations Manager overseeing service level objectives and multi-cloud platform availability.
modules: Open Table Formats and Storage Tiering
Enterprise Platform Integration and Strategic Roadmap
prerequisites: Participants must have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise architecture. Prior hands-on experience with SQL, basic cloud storage concepts across at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and fundamental knowledge of distributed systems is required. No programming language expertise beyond foundational SQL and shell scripting is necessary.
